property_summary: For any input value _val passed to SetMinSum by any caller before initialization, the reference contract sets MinSum to that same _val (i.e., MinSum() == _val); the mutant always sets MinSum to 0, violating this rule for any _val != 0.
change_summary: Change assignment to set MinSum to a constant 0 instead of the provided _val, altering observed value after the call.
